SELECT sa.id AS application_id, js.job_id, sa.schedule_id, j.title AS job_title, e.company_name, sa.status, js.schedule_date AS work_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, COALESCE(j.address, j.location, '') AS location, COALESCE((SELECT jr.amount FROM job_rates jr WHERE jr.job_id = j.id ORDER BY jr.id LIMIT 1), j.rate_amount) AS pay_amount, COALESCE((SELECT jr.type FROM job_rates jr WHERE jr.job_id = j.id ORDER BY jr.id LIMIT 1), j.rate_type) AS pay_type, sa.applied_at FROM schedule_applications sa LEFT JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id LEFT JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON j.company_id = e.id WHERE sa.worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC, sa.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
